text: Revise docs/design/defaults-loop.md in two ways. First, make every change listed in docs/design/reviews/defaults-loop-review-1.md, so it reaches 'accept'. Second, add introspection as a first-class step, from the BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-13: Introspection on every correction'. Every correction, intervention, rejection and failure triggers an introspection that Athena runs itself and records. The record covers: what happened, which class of failure it is and earlier cases of that class, the cause beyond this instance, what would have prevented it (a default, a check in code, or a design change), and a proposed next request. A retry starts from that record rather than from the user rewriting the request. The defaults loop consumes these records. Matching a new case to an earlier class is a typed decision suited to Jev, through /v1/evaluate. Use today's operator-found cases as evidence: CHANGELOG excluded by scope criteria (8qkc, m1bs); the reader budget failing four jobs in a row (69gf, t1y6, 3p3y, jk8v) while each retry only patched the last finding; 'checks not finished' on #47 with no diagnosis of a hung CI; a Haiku producer handing in untested work (69gf); a plan to edit the owner-only BRIEF.md (16zf); plans bundling design and build; Jev's interface assumed instead of checked. Design only.
